summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A., a foreign private issuer (Form 6-K equivalent to a US current report), announced a Board-approved declaration of Interest on Capital (IoC) – a mandatory dividend distribution, not a special-situation event. The gross amount is R$230,000,000 (≈ $42.3M at current rates), paid per share of R$0.07197 gross, with a 17.5% withholding tax. The record date is June 26, 2026, and payment by April 30, 2027. Adjustment for ongoing share buybacks is possible. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation, thus no risk-arb angle.
